title: A power saving for planar unit distances
summary: We prove a power saving for the planar unit-distance problem: for some absolute $`\beta\lt 4/3`$, every set of n points in the Euclidean plane determines $`O(n^\beta)`$ unordered pairs at unit distance.
family_title: Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds

review.reason: Proves a power saving for the number of unit-distance pairs among planar points.
